messages.content: "請問您能告訴我使用ARIMA模型的蘋果公司未來30天的股價預測，並提供使用LSTM模型的微軟未來45天的股票預測嗎？之後，您能提供紐約市未來7天的天氣預報，然後再給出洛杉磯未來14天的天氣預報嗎？"

function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieve a weather forecast for a specific location and time frame. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city that you want to get the weather for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.

function.name: stock_forecast
function.description: Predict the future stock price for a specific company and time frame. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

company.description: The company that you want to get the stock price prediction for.

days.description: Number of future days for which to predict the stock price.

model.description: The model to use for prediction. Default is 'ARIMA'.
